title: Silver Sit
description: Lightweight sit plugin with right-click support, toggle system, and smooth animations.
body:
## 🪑 SilverSit

A lightweight and polished sitting plugin for Minecraft servers.

---

### ✨ Features

* Sit anywhere with `/sit`
* Right-click blocks to sit
* Toggle right-click sitting per player
* Works with slabs, stairs, carpets, and campfires
* Prevent sitting in water or after taking damage
* Configurable settings
* Clean and lightweight

---

### ⚙️ Commands

* `/sit` — Sit down
* `/sittoggle` — Toggle right-click sitting
* `/sitreload` — Reload config

---

### 🔐 Permissions

* `silversit.use` — Use sit features
* `silversit.reload` — Reload config

---

### 🧩 Compatibility

* Paper / Spigot 1.21+

---

Made by Ecilpsee_
